name: Vigilante Coffee
notes: All 5 photos were menu boards, showing two different physical boards: photos 1-2 are an older white 'VIGILANTE COFFEE CO.' board with lower prices, and photos 3-5 are a newer black 'VIGILANTE COFFEE MENU' chalkboard (shown 3 of 5 times, and hanging below a 'NEW FEATURED TEAS' sign) with updated prices and a few new items (Apple Cider, Cinnamon Hibiscus tea, JoJo's Ice Cream, Bagel or Toast). Used the newer black board as the source since it recurs most and appears current; add-on modifiers (double shot, syrups, butter/jam/cream cheese/avo mash, 16oz upsize) were dropped per rules.
